edit.why: Pipeline M7 is the schematic's M8. Its drain ties to the M6 drain and the M10/M11 gate line.
The M8 gate is on the VNB2 bias net shared with M9.
The M8 source goes to the M10 drain.
Pipeline M8 is the schematic's M9. Its source goes to the M11 drain.
The M1 source goes to the tail node at the M3 drain. The hop at J1 means it is not joined to the vin- wire.
The M2 source goes to the tail node. Only the M2 gate connects to the vin- wire (net9).
